text:
I updated `public/index.html`. The first line in `<head>` is now `<!-- @trace DSN-042 REQ-001 REQ-002 REQ-003 REQ-004 REQ-005 REQ-008 REQ-009 -->`. I changed nothing else in the page. Typecheck is clean, but drift still reports two items.

The two drift items are the same design problem as last time. The design lists a dependency from `EventSubscriber` to `EventFeed` and one from `EventFeed` to `EventSubscriber`. I left both out of the code on purpose. The two classes run on different servers and talk over the ws feed, not through object references. You also said `EventFeed` must not hold an `EventSubscriber`.

To clear drift, the design needs to drop both relations. I can't change the design from here.
